bibliographic.title: Manca solo un verso a quella poesia - capitolo 1
bibliographic.author: Diavolo dei crocicchi
bibliographic.description:
This is a game that brings you in a fantasy world where you will meet fairies, goblins, killer rabbits and many more strange creatures that will help you to face the Death, who, apparently, is not your worst enemy...

This textual adventure can be played in a version with images, it is distributed with a .pdf guide.

links.title: Manca_Solo_Un_Verso_A_Quella_Poesia.zip
links.desc: Zip file includes a .z5 version fit for smartphone, basic .z5 file and a Glulx .blb file, as well as a .pdf guide and secrets.
